units.source_text: 源氏大将回想往昔，后悔之事甚多，但现已无可奈何。

en.t: General Genji thought back on the past and had many regrets, but now there was nothing he could do.

units.source_text: 天明后出行，有所未便，只得匆匆告别。

en.t: Since it would be inconvenient to leave after daybreak, he had no choice but to say a hurried farewell.
On the way back, the morning dew lay very heavily.

units.source_text: 六条妃子心情沮丧，别后忽忽若有所失，只是茫茫然地仰望天空。

en.t: The Lady of Rokujo was downcast; after parting from him, she felt dazed, as though she had lost something, and only gazed blankly up at the sky.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女回想源氏大将映着月光的姿态，闻到犹未消散的衣香，都心驰神往，竟忘记了野宫的神圣，大家极口赞叹。

en.t: The young gentlewomen remembered General Genji's figure in the moonlight and, smelling the lingering fragrance of his robes, were all carried away, forgetting even the sanctity of the Nonomiya shrine as they praised him to the skies.

units.source_text: 她们说：“如此俊秀之人，即使为了天大的事，也舍不得离别的！”

en.t: They said, "With someone so handsome, one could not bear to part from him, even for the most important matter in the world!"
They all began to cry for no reason at all.
